scripts.question-engine:refill-local: npm run build --workspace functions && node scripts/question-engine-refill-local.mjs
scripts.question-engine:publish-local: npm run build --workspace functions && node scripts/question-engine-publish-local.mjs
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build --workspace functions
scripts.emulators: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-test-arena --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-test-arena --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:local"
scripts.test:local: node scripts/seed-curriculum.mjs && node scripts/seed-demo.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/security.test.mjs tests/quiz.test.mjs tests/arena.test.mjs tests/analytics.test.mjs tests/bulk-students.test.mjs tests/curriculum.test.mjs tests/visual-quiz.test.mjs tests/math-engine.test.mjs tests/math-unit2.test.mjs && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/seed-curriculum.mjs && node scripts/seed-demo.mjs && playwright test
